public_rationale: Anthropic publicly released computer-use functionality in October 2024. Developers could direct Claude to interact with software on users' behalf. The company described the capability as experimental and error-prone, which fits Marcus's limited claim.
limitations: This establishes limited availability and functionality, not general reliability or widespread adoption.
The unquantified domestic-robot concession is not separately scored as a forecast.

from_speaker: AI systems that act in the world on user’s behalf

our_interpretation: An agent must execute some user-directed action, rather than merely describe an action. Actions in software count because the surrounding text explicitly includes websites.
Limited availability through a developer API qualifies; widespread consumer deployment is not required.
The domestic-robot phrase is concessive background, not a conditional antecedent or a separately dated forecast.
Use the latest completed product-reporting quarter before the post, October through December 2024, for the ongoing availability assertion.
criteria.support_condition: At least one publicly available AI system could perform limited actions for users during the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The purported systems were only proposals, or available systems could not execute actions for users.
